name: ayagmar-skills
description: Catalog of agent skills for planning and review workflows, commits, document summarization, local session history search and cost forensics, and X/Twitter post writing.

plugins.name: adversarial-plan-approval
plugins.description: Independently falsify or approve implementation plans before execution with ACCEPT, MODIFY, or REJECT verdicts per task or decision gate.

plugins.name: advisor-executor-quality-loop
plugins.description: Orchestrate complex multi-task work by separating advisor reasoning, delegated execution, and independent verification until tasks converge.

plugins.name: commit
plugins.description: Create Conventional Commits safely, including logical commit stacks over mixed working trees and plan-traceable commit sequences.

plugins.name: engineering-optimization
plugins.description: Improve performance, resource use, determinism, or simplicity through measurement, profiling, benchmarks, and proven equivalence.

plugins.name: implementation-plan-author
plugins.description: Author self-contained implementation plans, multi-plan programs, or compact handoffs that a fresh agent can execute without conversational memory.

plugins.name: improve
plugins.description: Survey a codebase as a senior advisor, report prioritized improvements, and implement selected fixes or produce handoff plans.

plugins.name: product-spec-foundry
plugins.description: Turn a product idea, loose PRD, or inconsistent pre-implementation repository into an implementation-ready specification package.

plugins.name: release-readiness-certification
plugins.description: Produce a strict evidence-based release verdict with severity-ranked findings, blockers, a pre-release work batch, and a deferred backlog.

plugins.name: session-cost-forensics
plugins.description: Analyze local Codex, Pi, and Claude Code session logs for cost, token waste, cache misses, retries, and duplicate sessions.

plugins.name: session-memory-search
plugins.description: Search local Codex, Pi, and Claude Code session history to recover prior decisions, feedback, prompts, and conversation snippets.

plugins.name: summarize
plugins.description: Fetch a URL or convert a local file (PDF, DOCX, HTML, and more) into Markdown with markitdown, optionally summarizing it.

plugins.name: x-post-craft
plugins.description: Write and review X/Twitter posts and threads using the reach mechanics of X's open-source recommendation stack.
